text:
Sebastian Muller  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972-52-345-6789 | sebastian.muller@neonpixel.com  

Professional Experience  
As a Staff Data Engineer at NeonPixel Games, I lead the architecture and scaling of data infrastructure supporting real-time analytics, player behavior modeling, and cross-platform data integration. My focus spans cloud-native systems, distributed processing, and data governance frameworks. Prior to this, I served as Lead Data Engineer, where I rearchitected ETL pipelines to reduce latency by 40% and designed a scalable data warehouse for global user metrics. Earlier roles included Data Engineer at Luminous Interactive, where I built AWS-based solutions for high-velocity data ingestion and optimized Spark workflows for game telemetry. My career began as a Data Analyst Intern at PixelForge Studios, where I laid the foundation for data-driven decision-making in game development.  

Education  
Master’s in Computer Science, Technical University of Munich, 2010. Thesis: Distributed Query Optimization in Real-Time Analytics Systems.  

Technical Skills  
AWS: Designed and maintained cloud architectures for global data pipelines, mentoring teams on cost optimization and security best practices. Apache Airflow: Spearheaded orchestration of complex workflows, integrating Kafka, Spark, and Snowflake for seamless data flow. Apache Kafka: Engineered real-time data ingestion platforms, handling terabytes of player activity data with low-latency guarantees. Apache Spark: Optimized batch and stream processing pipelines, reducing job execution times by 30% through partitioning and caching strategies. Data Warehousing: Pioneered Snowflake-based solutions for centralized analytics, enabling cross-team collaboration on player segmentation and monetization metrics. ETL Pipeline Design: Built scalable architectures for data integration, ensuring compliance with GDPR and internal data quality standards. Python: Developed custom scripts for data validation and automation, reducing manual effort in data pipeline maintenance. Terraform: Automated infrastructure provisioning for cloud environments, ensuring reproducibility and consistency across development, staging, and production.  

Projects  
1. **Player Analytics Platform**: Architectured a real-time analytics system using Kafka for event streaming, Spark for processing, and Snowflake for storage, enabling rapid insights into user behavior.  
2. **Global Data Warehouse**: Redesigned the data warehouse to support multi-region compliance, improving query performance by 50% through partitioning and indexing strategies.  
3. **CI/CD Pipeline for Data Infrastructure**: Implemented Terraform and CI/CD practices to automate environment provisioning, reducing deployment time by 60%.  

Certifications  
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (2021)  
Apache Airflow Certified Administrator (2022)  

Languages  
English (fluent), German (fluent), Hebrew (proficient)  

Awards & Achievements  
Recognized as Staff Data Engineer at NeonPixel Games for driving innovation in cloud-native data architectures. Led the migration of legacy ETL systems to a modern data lake, improving data freshness and reducing operational costs by 25%. Contributed to the development of internal data governance frameworks, enhancing cross-team collaboration and data integrity.
